description: This independent companion guide invites readers back into the world of Andy Weir's debut novel *The Martian* — the story of Mark Watney, the Ares 3 mission's botany specialist and mechanical engineer, stranded on the surface of Mars after a storm forces an emergency evacuation. Left behind when the crew flees to their ascent vehicle, Watney wages a desperate one-man campaign of survival, coaxing food from Martian soil and rigging solutions from scraps, all while trying to signal Earth that he's still breathing. The sidekick unpacks layers readers might have raced past on a first pass: buried themes, character motivations, and quiet details woven through Weir's science-driven narrative. It also toys with alternate endings and prequel possibilities, extending the visit with a crew whose ingenuity made the original such a draw.
subtitle: A Sidekick to the Andy Weir Novel
title: The Martian

description: Six days after becoming one of the first humans to walk on Mars, astronaut Mark Watney is pretty sure he's about to become the first to die there. A vicious dust storm tore through the mission, left him gravely injured, and drove his crew to evacuate believing he was already gone. Now he's utterly alone on a hostile planet with no way to signal Earth — and even if he could, his supplies would run out long before any rescue could reach him. Starvation might be the least of his worries; broken equipment, the merciless Martian environment, or simple human error are all far more likely to finish him off first. But Mark has no intention of giving up. Armed with engineering chops, relentless ingenuity, and a stubborn refusal to quit, he tackles one impossible problem after another. This edition also includes bonus writings from Watney himself — including a new astronaut's diary, two letters home to Mom, and a postscript available here for the first time.
title: The Martian

description: Johnsmith Biberkopf breaks out of a Martian penal colony and discovers that the visions he has been dismissing as madness are something else entirely — space and time bend to his will. Vikings who have navigated the continua since antiquity snatch him aboard their ships, pulling him into a voyage across the multiverse with no visible end. Alien threats confront him at every turn, and the deeper he travels, the more he grasps about the genuine and frightening reach of illusion itself.
title: The Martian Viking

description: Earth's first expedition to Mars vanishes without explanation. A second crew is dispatched to investigate, but only Captain Wilder carries the real, classified orders — and his anthropologist Spender has already guessed the darker purpose behind humanity's arrival. Convinced that colonization will extinguish the last remnants of an ancient Martian people, Spender goes rogue, forcing the duty-bound Wilder to hunt her through the planet's mountains before she can sabotage the mission any further. The fate of an entire civilization hangs on what happens in that pursuit, even as Earth itself slides toward a global catastrophe that puts the survival of the human race in jeopardy. This audio dramatization reimagines Bradbury's classic colonization fable with a full cast, and includes a behind-the-scenes documentary and six companion pieces exploring Martian culture.
subtitle: A Full-Cast BBC Radio 4 Drama
title: The Martian Chronicles

description: Elma York steps onto Martian soil carrying the weight of a displaced humanity. Decades after a meteorite wiped out Washington, DC, and set off runaway climate collapse, Earth's survivors have pushed outward to space stations and the Moon — Mars is the next frontier, and Elma's crew is there to lay the groundwork for the first real wave of settlers. Their mandate runs deeper than erecting habitats: they mean to carry Earth's cultures forward without dragging along its bigotries. From the moment she arrives, though, something feels wrong. Disturbing clues suggest the First Mars Expedition suffered a catastrophe that someone scrubbed from the official record, and every question Elma's team asks meets a wall of silence. Construction stalls as the investigation deepens, and the stakes sharpen — if the truth stays buried, humanity's best chance off a dying world could collapse with it.
subtitle: Lady Astronaut, Book 4
title: The Martian Contingency

description: Earth sends its people to Mars in waves — each arrival different, each more forceful than the last. Bradbury's Mars is a world of crystal pillars and fossil seas, where fine dust drifts through the great, empty cities of a civilization destroyed in silence. The settlers come to despoil and commercialize, fleeing a dying homeworld for the promise of tomorrow. They conquer the planet, and then the planet conquers them — lulling the invaders with dangerous comforts, enchanting them with the lingering glamour of an ancient, mysterious native race. In connected, chronological stories, these chronicles hold a stark mirror up to humanity in brilliant spacelight: our strength, our weakness, our folly, laid bare on a breathtaking world where we do not belong.
title: The Martian Chronicles

description: An enormous airship looms over 1892 New York, and its ultimatum is blunt: bow to the Martian flag or face annihilation. The inventor-adventurer known only as Smith takes up the chase, working the case from Chinatown's basement fan-tan parlors to the torch of the Statue of Liberty with his sharp-witted assistant, April Malone, at his side. Clues scatter through backroom Tammany Hall dealings and open skies where airships clash, and the threat behind every corner keeps the stakes climbing. To stand any chance of stopping the menace, Smith calls on Theodore Roosevelt and a cadre of turn-of-the-century notables, as the world teeters on the edge of open war.
subtitle: Chronological Man, Book 2
title: The Martian Emperor

description: Earth is dying, and humanity looks outward — to Mars, where crystal pillars rise above fossil seas and fine dust drifts through the empty cities of a vanished civilization. Explorers arrive first as a trickle, then as a torrent, fleeing a world with no future to claim a new one. They come to colonize and commercialize, to despoil and build. Mars answers them with dangerous comfort: echoes of home, illusions of familiarity, the lingering glamour of an ancient and mysterious native people. The conquerors take the planet — and then the planet takes them, lulling them into forgetting what they came from and what they were supposed to become.
subtitle: A Radio Dramatization
title: Ray Bradbury's the Martian Chronicles

description: A rocket explosion kills four crewmen and the United States washes its hands of Mars, redirecting its ambitions to near-Earth projects. Tycoon John Axelrod sees an opening: he assembles a private consortium to bankroll the mission himself, eyeing billions in return. He is not alone in that ambition. A European-Asian coalition is preparing its own expedition aboard an airbus bound for the same destination, and whoever touches down first will claim the prize. What follows is a hard-science sprint to the Red Planet, where engineering, money, and geopolitical pride collide at interplanetary scale.
title: The Martian Race

description: A science-fiction writer from California adopts an eight-year-old boy named Dennis who is hyperactive, deeply insecure, and firmly convinced that he is a Martian. What follows is a two-year effort to win the trust of a child who aches for a father's love but cannot bring himself to believe he deserves one. This semi-autobiographical memoir traces the small, daily negotiations of building a family — the comedy, the frustration, and the moments of raw tenderness that come with earning a frightened boy's acceptance.
title: The Martian Child
